The goal of this document is to look through all of the variables of interest and
make sure they are behaving in ways that seem correct. This will mainly involve
looking at histograms and trying to do some quality checks.
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
local_dir1 <- '/Users/victorpokorny/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-vpokorny123@gmail.com/My Drive/CAPR CHR Functioning/RData/'
local_dir<- paste0(local_dir1)
load(paste0(local_dir,'merged_data.RData'))
source("~/Desktop/R_functions/funcs.R")

converters_subs<- c("20099", "20322", "20248", "20209", "20960", "30498", "30665",
         "40271", "51018", "51028", "60591", "20559", "31130", "20613",
         "51253", "50088", "40695", "51187", "31266", "51400", "51484",
         "31306", "31501", "20907", "41491")
merged_df$conversion<- ifelse(merged_df$src_subject_id %in% converters_subs,1,0)

# i think wide might be helpful for some inspections
wide_df<-pivot_wider(merged_df, names_from = 'visit', values_from = -c('src_subject_id','visit'))


```

```{r}
vars_to_inspect <- c('gfr_current_bl','gfr_current_12m','gfr_current_24m',
                     'gfs_current_bl','gfs_current_12m','gfs_current_24m')
for (j in vars_to_inspect){
  label = j
  vjp_hist(wide_df[[j]],j)
}

#these are all reasonable correlations
scatterplot(wide_df$gfr_current_bl, wide_df$gfr_current_12m)
scatterplot(wide_df$gfr_current_bl, wide_df$gfr_current_24m)
scatterplot(wide_df$gfs_current_bl, wide_df$gfs_current_12m)
scatterplot(wide_df$gfs_current_bl, wide_df$gfs_current_24m)

# should be correlated
scatterplot(merged_df$gfr_current,merged_df$gfs_current)
```

```{r}
# kamin
# the values below represent a 1 or 0 response from a single trial that is normalized by "confidence"
# my primary concern about the confidence scores is that they are confounded with reaction time
# likely a good idea to look at non-normalized scores as well
# i also have a hankering to look at multiple trials, but maybe that's what the computational 
# modeling is for?
#the distributions are horrifically non-normal, but expectedly bimodal
vars_to_inspect <- c('kamin_blocking_score','kamin_control_score',
                     'kamin_blocking_score_raw', 'kamin_control_score_raw')
for (j in vars_to_inspect){
  label = j
  vjp_hist(merged_df[[j]],j)
}

#we probably want to drop folks with a 0 on the trial we care about?
```

```{r}
#sws
vars_to_inspect <- 
  c('hit_sum_pre', #"intelligible" condition and response = 1 before hearing the sentences
    'hit_sum_post', #same as above but after hearing the sentences
    'miss_sum_pre', #"intelligible" condition and response = 0 before hearing the sentences
    'miss_sum_post', #same as above but after hearing the sentences
    'false_sum_pre', #"unintelligible" condition and response = 1 before hearing the sentences
    'false_sum_post', #same as above but after hearing the sentences
    'correj_sum_pre', #"unintelligible" condition and response = 0 before hearing the sentences
    'correj_sum_post',  #same as above but after hearing the sentences
    'dprime_pre', #ability to guess that the task wanted you to say the low freq is "intelligible"
    'dprime_post',
    'c_pre', #liberal or conservative response bias; this is what we actually care about
    'c_post',
    'beta_pre', #another measure of response bias; keeping cuz correlates with c < .8
    'beta_post',
    'd_change','c_change','beta_change')

for (j in vars_to_inspect){
  label = j
  vjp_hist(merged_df[[j]],j)
}


```

```{r}
merged_df<-merged_df %>% mutate(
  `Role Functioning`                = gfr_current,
  `Social Functioning`              = gfs_current,
   `Blocking Score (Kamin)`                   = kamin_blocking_score,
  `Gain vs Loss Avoidance (GLAT)`            = glat_GAINvLA,
  #need to compute acquisition win vs loss because above is test phase
  #Gold et al. says to subtract fourth block 90%
  `Gain vs Loss (Acquisition)` = glat_Win90_4 - glat_LA90_4,
  `Win-Stays (PRL)`                          = prl_total_win_stays,
  `Win-Switches (PRL)`                       = prl_total_win_switches,
  `Large Reward K (Delay Discounting)`       = LrgK,
  `K (Delay Discounting)`                    = logAvgK,
  `Context Sensitivity (Ebbinghaus)`         = context_sensitivity_all_trials,
  `Change in d' (SWS)`                       = d_change,
  `Inverted Face Reports (Mooney Faces)`     = inverted_faces_reported,
  `Hits All (SWS)`                           = hit_sum_all,
  `Speech Reports (SWS)`                     = total_yes_responses_all,
  `Finger Tapping Speed (CFT)`               = meantaps_dominant,
  `High Effort, High Reward Scores (EEFRT)`  = eefrt_Highest_Mag_HardProp, 
  `Omega3 Volatility (CH)`                   = ch_omega3,
  `Nu Evidence vs. Belief (CH)`              = ch_nu, 
  `Hedonic Reactivity (HR)`                  = iaps_PosPleasant,
  phenotype_four_groups                      = as.factor(phenotype_four_groups)
)
save(merged_df,
     file = paste0(local_dir,'merged_data_sparse.RData'))


#wide_df<-tidyr::pivot_wider(merged_df, names_from = 'visit', 
#                            values_from = -c('src_subject_id','visit'))
#now save out sparser df
#let's create some prettier names and then save out
wide_df<-wide_df %>% mutate(
  `Blocking Score (Kamin)`                   = kamin_blocking_score_bl,
  `Gain vs Loss Avoidance (GLAT)`            = glat_GAINvLA_bl,
  `Win-Stays (PRL)`                          = prl_total_win_stays_bl,
  `Win-Switches (PRL)`                       = prl_total_win_switches_bl,
  `Large Reward K (Delay Discounting)`       = LrgK_bl,
  `K (Delay Discounting)`                    = logAvgK_bl,
  `Context Sensitivity (Ebbinghaus)`         = context_sensitivity_all_trials_bl,
  `Change in d' (SWS)`                       = d_change_bl,
   #Win90_4 = as.numeric(substr(glat_Win90_4_bl, 1, nchar(glat_Win90_4_bl) - 1)),
   #LA90_4 = as.numeric(substr(glat_LA90_4_bl, 1, nchar(glat_LA90_4_bl) - 1)),
  `Gain vs Loss (Acquisition)` = glat_Win90_4_bl - glat_LA90_4_bl,
  `Inverted Face Reports (Mooney Faces)`     = inverted_faces_reported_bl,
  `Hits All (SWS)`                           = hit_sum_all_bl,
  `Speech Reports (SWS)`                     = total_yes_responses_all_bl,
  `Finger Tapping Speed (CFT)`               = meantaps_dominant_bl,
  `High Effort, High Reward Scores (EEFRT)`  = eefrt_Highest_Mag_HardProp_bl, 
  `Omega3 Volatility (CH)`                   = ch_omega3_bl,
  `Nu Evidence vs. Belief (CH)`              = ch_nu_bl, 
  `Hedonic Reactivity (HR)`                  = iaps_PosPleasant_bl,
  `Baseline Role Functioning`                = gfr_current_bl,
  `Baseline Social Functioning`              = gfs_current_bl,
  `12m Role Functioning`                     = gfr_current_12m,
  `12m Social Functioning`                   = gfs_current_12m,
  `24m Role Functioning`                     = gfr_current_12m,
  `24m Social Functioning`                   = gfs_current_12m,
  `12m Change Role Functioning`              = gfr_current_12m - gfr_current_bl,
  `12m Change Social Functioning`            = gfs_current_12m - gfs_current_bl,
  `24m Change Role Functioning`              = gfr_current_24m - gfr_current_bl,
  `24m Change Social Functioning`            = gfs_current_24m - gfs_current_bl, 
  `12m to 24m Change Role Functioning`       = gfr_current_24m - gfr_current_12m,
  `12m to 24m Change Social Functioning`     = gfs_current_24m - gfs_current_12m
)
wide_df$gfr_change_groups<- ifelse(wide_df$`12m Change Role Functioning` <= -1,
                                   'negative',
                               ifelse(wide_df$`12m Change Role Functioning` >=1,
                                      'positive','stable'))
wide_df$gfs_change_groups<- ifelse(wide_df$`12m Change Social Functioning` <= -1,
                                   'negative',
                               ifelse(wide_df$`12m Change Social Functioning` >=1,
                                      'positive','stable'))

#create timepoint 1 and timepoint 2 variables so we can include folks that missed 12m,
#but came in for 24m
wide_df<- wide_df %>% 
  mutate(
    `Timepoint 1 Social Functioning` = gfs_current_bl,
    `Timepoint 1 Role Functioning` = gfr_current_bl,
    `Timepoint 2 Social Functioning` = case_when(
           #when 12m is missing, but 24m is not then 24m becomes time 2
           is.na(gfs_current_12m) &
             !is.na(gfs_current_24m) ~ gfs_current_24m,
           #else time2 = gfs_current_12m
           .default = gfs_current_12m),
    `Timepoint 2 Role Functioning` = case_when(
           #when 12m is missing, but 24m is not then 24m becomes time 2
           is.na(gfr_current_12m) &
             !is.na(gfr_current_24m) ~ gfr_current_24m,
           #else time2 = gfs_current_12m
           .default = gfr_current_12m),
    `Timepoint Change Social Functioning` = `Timepoint 2 Social Functioning` -
                                            `Timepoint 1 Social Functioning`,
    `Timepoint Change Role Functioning` = `Timepoint 2 Role Functioning` -
                                            `Timepoint 1 Role Functioning`)

#save out
save(wide_df, file = paste0(local_dir,'wide_data_sparse.RData'))

```
